lab_questions.title: Fix Production API Latency Caused by an N+1 Query Problem
lab_questions.description: A backend service in Django REST Framework is suffering from severe performance degradation under load. Read through the codebase, identify the intentional N+1 query regression, and optimize the ORM execution to reduce SQL queries to an absolute minimum.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py seed_data && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Optimize N+1 Query Bottleneck in Orders API
tasks.description: Analyze the `/api/orders/` endpoint and optimize the queryset so that related customer, product, and category data are retrieved in <= 4 queries.
